title: senecio coccineus
intro: Senecio coccineus, commonly known as Scarlet Flame Flower or Red Senecio, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Senecio coccineus include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe the respiratory tract and alleviate coughing. The bioactive constituents of Senecio coccineus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
